text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That was a run worthy of Oguri-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "That is the very strength of yours that I have yearned so desperately to overcome."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad to have
a rival like you."

Yaeno Muteki and Oguri Cap.
The radiant smiles of both girls brought the
Arima Kinen to a glorious close—
